name: 小糸
text:
こうやってると、撮影だってこと
忘れちゃうよね……
trans:
I'm so relaxed... 
it's easy to forget we're even filming...!

name: 雛菜
text:
透先輩～
こっち入った～？
trans:
Toru-senpai～
Have you tried this one yet～?

name: 小糸
text:
ひ、雛菜ちゃん……！
そんなに急がなくても……！
trans:
W-Wait, Hinana-chan...!
There's no need to run...!

name: 小糸
text:
そ、そうだね
結構長い間、お風呂にいたから
trans:
R-Right?
We were in there for so long.

name: 小糸
text: ちょっと、のぼせそうだったね
trans: The heat almost makes you dizzy, huh?

name: 雛菜
text:
あは～
でも楽しかった～！

name: 雛菜
text:
ブクブクしてるやつとか～
サウナとか～、お肌つるつるになるやつとか！
trans:
The bath with lots of bubbles～ and the sauna～!
Even the one that makes your skin all silky smooth～!

name: 小糸
text:
撮る時『普通に遊びにきたつもりで自由に楽しんでみて』
って言われたもんね
trans:
After the director told us to go have fun, to 
"act as we normally would"...

name: 小糸
text:
そ、そしたらみんな違う種類のお風呂に
入りに行っちゃったけど……！
trans:
E-Everyone suddenly split off to try all the 
different baths...!

name: 透
text:
驚いてた
カメラマンの人
trans:
We shocked him.
The guy filming.

name: 小糸
text:
み、みんな一緒に入っていくって
思ってたんだろうね……
trans: I-I guess they thought we'd all stick together, huh...

name: 雛菜
text:
だってみんな
入りたいのばらばらだったでしょ～？
trans:
Because we want to do different things～! 
We're always all over the place～

name: 円香
text:
でも結局全員、
一周はしたんじゃない
trans: In the end, didn't we try everything at least once?

name: 小糸
text:
わたしも最初は『自由に楽しんで』って
どうしようって思ったけど……
trans:
When they said we should "just enjoy ourselves" 
I had no idea what to do at first...

name: 小糸
text:
ほ、ほんとにお仕事だって忘れちゃうくらい
くつろいじゃった……！
trans:
B-But then the baths made me feel so relaxed...
I actually forgot we were working...!

name: 円香
text:
……まあ、特に問題はなかったみたいだし
良い写真が撮れたって言ってたから
trans:
...Well, despite it all, it went smoothly. 
Seems like they got some good photos.

name: 円香
trans: All's well that ends well, I guess.

name: 雛菜
text:
ね、雛菜喉乾いちゃった～
サウナとかですっごい汗かいたし
trans:
The sauna was so warm that
Hinana's throat is all dry now～

name: 円香
trans: There's a vending machine over there.

name: 雛菜
text:
ん～……何にしよう
コーヒー牛乳か、フルーツ牛乳～……
trans:
Mmm... what should we get～?
Coffee flavored milk～? Or fruit flavored milk～?

name: 透
text:
じゃ、ヨーグルト
飲むやつ

name: 雛菜
text:
ん～、じゃあ
雛菜はフルーツにしよ～
trans:
Hmmm～
The fruity one for Hinana then～!

name: 小糸
text:
え、えっとわたしは……
どうしようかな……
trans:
U-Um... for me...
what should I go for...?

name: 小糸
text: ……い、いちご牛乳にしようかな

name: 雛菜
text:
あは～
やっぱり全員ばらばら～
trans:
Aha～
We really are all over the place～

name: 円香
text: 合わせる必要もないし
trans: It's not like we all have to be the same, so...
